answers.core: This is a simple feature that most people (and, in fact, many I've discussed this with) would expect to already be within the engine by default. It also pertains to the editor, and is so minor not to warrant a plugin.
answers.workaround: To my knowledge, the only workaround would be to add several "dummy" values that go unused, in order to force godot to use the compressed form, which leads to the value being harder to read.

title: Add support for exposing custom bitflags in the inspector with the same UI as physics/navigation layers
